component-metadata.author: knimeuser
component-metadata.description:
Metanode for the quantification of proteins using peptide intensities. Both protein and peptide table are required to run this metanode.
This metanode is using the DIA-TPA algorithm presented by He et al., 2020 (DOI: 10.1016/j.jprot.2019.03.005) and MaxLFQ and Top3 quantifications as implemented in the iq R package (Pham et al. 2020, DOI: 10.1093/bioinformatics/btz961).
As the top input, use a protein table into which newly calculated protein quantities should be inserted. As the bottom input, table containing information about peptide intensities (not transformed) should be used, this table will be used for the protein quantification. To correctly insert the new values into the top table, columns with matching protein IDs need to be selected both from the top and bottom (peptide) table.
Before MaxLFQ or Top3 quantification, median normalization of peptide intensities can be performed to normalize intensities between samples. In case of DIA-NN outputs, if Precursor.Normalised columns are to be used, this median normalization is not necessary.
It is possible to return values in several formats, apart from the absolute values calculated by the selected algorithm, log2, ppm or percentages can be returned.
